title: DAF CF85 FUPS Compliant Polished Hi-Tensile Aluminium Custom BullBar #1
description: DAF CF85 FUPS Compliant Polished Hi-Tensile Aluminium Custom Bull Bar, features low uprights to allow front panel to open without dropping the bullbar. 76mm diameter high tensile aluminium tubing with pressed height tensile main channel. High tensile aluminium backing plate with 38mm tow pin. Recessed lights in main channel and Dangerous Goods Signs on mounting plates. Combination LED indicator/parking lights recessed into outer channels. The bullbar can be customised to suit your application.
